text: In the Appeltant et al. (2011) time-multiplexed reservoir, a single nonlinear node with delayed feedback emulates a whole network by defining N ___ nodes spaced theta = tau/N apart within the delay loop.
explanation: The scheme time-multiplexes N virtual nodes into a delay loop of length tau at spacing theta = tau/N (with theta about 0.2 times the node response time), so one physical nonlinear element emulates an entire recurrent network.
